answer: The AIC of the logistic regression model using BMI as the sole predictor of treatment response (efficacy PR coded as 1 = PR, 0 = SD/PD; n = 80) is approximately 111.81 (AIC = −2·logLik + 2k = −2(−53.906) + 2×2, k = 2 parameters: intercept + BMI). This comes from a statsmodels binomial Logit (ML fit) on the 80 real patients in data.xlsx Sheet1 (41 blank artifact rows dropped); BMI enters as a continuous linear predictor. Alternative codings considered: a 3-level multinomial model of Efficacy (rejected as inconsistent with "logistic regression") and a PR-vs-SD-only model (n = 58, rejected); the approved PR-vs-non-PR coding was used. For context, BMI is not a significant predictor (p ≈ 0.087), so the model fits only slightly better than the intercept-only null.
